note: The program transfers NATIVE SOL (lamports). The asset is identified in the domain-separated proof by the wrapped-SOL mint sentinel. Amounts are ALWAYS integer atomic units (lamports) encoded as decimal strings; never floats.

assets.notes: Transfers are native lamports moved from the vault PDA. The wSOL mint is used only as the asset identifier bound into the proof (asset-scoping + forward-compat). No SPL token account is touched.

roadmap.spl_support: When SPL/token-2022 assets are added, register each real mint here with its decimals and atomic unit, and extend claim_reward to move tokens via CPI. Until then only native-sol is accepted.
